title: How to Remain Loyal When We Face Tests of Faith
meta: Awit Blg. 122 & 123 | "Panginoon, kanino kami pupunta? Nasa iyo ang mga salitang nagbibigay ng buhay na walang hanggan." - Juan 6:68

question.en: What happened as Jesus was teaching in Capernaum?
question.tl: Ano ang nangyari noong nagtuturo si Jesus sa Capernaum?

direct.en: While Jesus was teaching in Capernaum, many disciples were shocked by his words about eating his flesh and drinking his blood. They had previously been impressed by his works and even recognized him as the Prophet who was to come. But when they faced a test of faith, they were offended and stopped following him. (John 6:60; John 6:53, 54; John 6:14)
direct.tl: Noong nagtuturo si Jesus sa Capernaum, marami sa mga alagad niya ang nagulat sa sinabi niya tungkol sa pagkain ng kaniyang laman at pag-inom ng kaniyang dugo. Dati, hanga sila sa ginawa ni Jesus at kinilala pa siyang Propeta na darating. Pero nang masubok ang pananampalataya nila, hindi nila ito natanggap at tumigil sila sa pagsunod. (Juan 6:60; Juan 6:53, 54; Juan 6:14)

deeper.en: This teaches me that faith based only on excitement can weaken when something is hard to understand. Those disciples had seen powerful evidence, but offense replaced loyalty. Jehovah wants our faith to go deeper than emotion. When I do not fully understand something, that is when I need humility, patience, and trust.
deeper.tl: Itinuturo nito na ang pananampalatayang nakabase lang sa excitement ay puwedeng humina kapag may hindi maintindihan. Nakakita na ang mga alagad na iyon ng matibay na ebidensiya, pero napalitan ng pagkatisod ang loyalty nila. Gusto ni Jehova na mas malalim ang faith natin kaysa emotion.

paragraph.en:
“THIS speech is shocking; who can listen to it?” ( John 6:60 ) That is the way that many of Jesus’ disciples reacted to statements Jesus made while he was teaching in Capernaum. Jesus had said: “Unless you eat the flesh of the Son of man and drink his blood, you have no life in yourselves.” And he continued: “Whoever feeds on my flesh and drinks my blood has everlasting life, and I will resurrect him on the last day.”​— John 6:53, 54 .

Those who were deeply offended by Jesus’ words stopped following him. Did they not have any faith in him at all? Actually, before this incident some​—including Jesus’ disciples—​were so impressed by what Jesus did that they said: “This really is the Prophet who was to come into the world.” ( John 6:14 ) So it is evident that those disciples had a degree of faith in Jesus. But when their faith was tested, they did not remain loyal to him.
paragraph.tl:
“NAKAKAKILABOT ang mga sinabi niya; sino ang makikinig sa ganiyang pananalita?” ( Juan 6:60 ) Iyan ang reaksiyon ng marami sa mga alagad ni Jesus nang marinig nila ang sinabi niya habang nagtuturo sa Capernaum. Ano ba ang sinabi ni Jesus? “Kung hindi ninyo kakainin ang katawan ng Anak ng tao at iinumin ang kaniyang dugo, hindi kayo magkakaroon ng buhay. Ang sinumang kumakain ng aking katawan at umiinom ng aking dugo ay magkakaroon ng buhay na walang hanggan, at bubuhayin ko siyang muli sa huling araw.”​— Juan 6:​53, 54 .

Dahil hindi matanggap ng mga alagad na iyon ang sinabi ni Jesus, hindi na sila sumunod sa kaniya. Ibig bang sabihin, wala silang pananampalataya sa kaniya? Lumilitaw na mayroon naman. Kasi bago nito, nakita nila ang ginawa ni Jesus at nasabi nila: “Ito talaga ang Propeta na darating sa mundo.” ( Juan 6:14 ) Iyon nga lang, nang masubok na ang pananampalataya nila, hindi sila nanatiling tapat kay Jesus.

question.en: How did the apostles react to Jesus' words, and why? (See also picture.)
question.tl: Ano ang naging reaksiyon ng mga apostol sa sinabi ni Jesus, at bakit? (Tingnan din ang larawan.)

direct.en: The apostles reacted with loyalty. Peter said: "Lord, whom shall we go away to? You have sayings of everlasting life." They may not have fully understood Jesus' words, but they stayed because they were convinced of who he was. Their faith rested on the truth that Jesus was the Christ of God and had Jehovah's support. (John 6:68, 69; Luke 9:20, 35)
direct.tl: Iba ang naging reaksiyon ng mga apostol. Sinabi ni Pedro: "Panginoon, kanino kami pupunta? Nasa iyo ang mga salitang nagbibigay ng buhay na walang hanggan." Maaaring hindi pa nila lubusang naintindihan ang sinabi ni Jesus, pero nanatili sila dahil kumbinsido sila kung sino siya. Naniniwala silang si Jesus ang Kristo ng Diyos at sinusuportahan siya ni Jehova. (Juan 6:68, 69; Lucas 9:20, 35)

deeper.en: Peter's answer helps me see what loyalty looks like when understanding is incomplete. He did not say, "We understand everything." He said, in effect, "We know whom we trust." That draws me closer to Jehovah because he does not ask us to know every detail immediately. He asks us to trust what we already know is true.
deeper.tl: Tinutulungan ako ng sagot ni Pedro na makita kung ano ang loyalty kapag hindi pa kumpleto ang understanding. Hindi niya sinabing, "Naiintindihan namin ang lahat." Parang sinabi niya, "Alam namin kung kanino kami nagtitiwala." Hindi hinihiling ni Jehova na alam natin agad ang bawat detalye; gusto niyang magtiwala tayo sa alam nating totoo.

paragraph.en: The apostles reacted differently to Jesus’ words. When Jesus asked them if they wanted to leave him as well, Peter answered: “Lord, whom shall we go away to? You have sayings of everlasting life. We have believed and have come to know that you are the Holy One of God.” ( John 6:68, 69 ) Notice that Peter did not say that he and the other apostles fully understood the meaning of what Jesus said when he told them that they needed to eat his flesh and drink his blood. Regardless of what they understood at that moment, they chose to remain loyal to Jesus. Why? Because their faith was based on an undeniable truth​—Jesus was “the Christ of God.”​— Luke 9:20, 35 .
paragraph.tl: Ibang-iba ang naging reaksiyon ng mga apostol sa reaksiyon ng mga alagad na iyon. Nang tanungin sila ni Jesus kung gusto rin ba nilang umalis, sumagot si Pedro: “Panginoon, kanino kami pupunta? Nasa iyo ang mga salitang nagbibigay ng buhay na walang hanggan. Naniwala kami at alam namin na ikaw ang isinugo ng Diyos.” ( Juan 6:​68, 69 ) Pansinin na hindi sinabi ni Pedro na lubusan niyang naintindihan at ng iba pang apostol ang sinabi ni Jesus tungkol sa pagkain sa katawan niya at pag-inom sa dugo niya. Pero anuman ang naisip nila tungkol doon, nanatili pa rin silang tapat kay Jesus. Bakit? Kasi naniniwala sila na si Jesus ang “Kristo ng Diyos.”​— Luc. 9:​20, 35 .

question.tl: Ano ang mga posibleng sumubok sa katapatan natin kay Jehova?

direct.en: Our loyalty to Jehovah can be tested in several ways. We may learn of an adjustment in understanding or a change in how the disciple-making work is organized. We may struggle to understand why Jehovah allows a tragedy. Our faith can also be tested when a close friend hurts us or when someone we respect treats us unfairly.
direct.tl: Puwedeng masubok ang katapatan natin kay Jehova sa iba't ibang paraan. Baka magkaroon ng adjustment sa pagkaunawa natin sa isang teksto o pagbabago sa paraan ng pangangaral. Baka mahirapan tayong maintindihan kung bakit hinayaan ni Jehova ang isang trahedya. Puwede ring masubok tayo kapag nasaktan tayo ng malapít na kaibigan o ng taong iginagalang natin.

deeper.en: This paragraph is realistic. It shows that tests of faith are not always persecution from outside. Sometimes the test is confusion, pain, disappointment, or hurt feelings. Since no scripture is cited in the paragraph, I would keep the point simple: Jehovah knows loyalty can be tested in very personal ways, and he can help us stay close to him through them.
deeper.tl: Realistic ang paragraph na ito. Ipinapakita nitong hindi lang persecution mula sa labas ang sumusubok sa faith. Minsan ang test ay confusion, pain, disappointment, o nasaktang damdamin. Dahil walang binanggit na teksto rito, simple ang punto: alam ni Jehova na personal ang ilang pagsubok, at kaya niya tayong tulungang manatiling malapít.

paragraph.en: Our loyalty to Jehovah can be tested in a number of ways. For example, how do we react when we learn of an adjustment in the understanding of a Bible verse or of a change in the way that the disciple-making work is organized? Or how do we react when we find it hard to understand why Jehovah allows us to suffer some kind of tragedy? Our faith can also be tested if a close Christian friend hurts us or if someone we respect treats us in a way that seems unfair.
paragraph.tl: May mga sitwasyon na posibleng sumubok sa katapatan natin kay Jehova. Halimbawa, baka magkaroon ng pagbabago sa unawa natin sa isang teksto sa Bibliya o sa paraan natin ng pangangaral. O baka makaranas tayo ng isang trahedya at maisip natin kung bakit hinayaan ni Jehova na mangyari iyon. Puwede ring masubok ang katapatan natin kung masaktan tayo ng isang kapatid na malapít sa atin o kung pakiramdam natin, may ginawang mali sa atin ang isang taong iginagalang natin.

question.en: Illustrate why our faith needs to be built on a strong foundation. (Colossians 1:23)
question.tl: Bakit dapat nating patibayin ang pananampalataya natin? Magbigay ng ilustrasyon. (Colosas 1:23)

direct.en: Our faith needs a strong foundation because tests of faith can shake us, just as earthquakes shake buildings. A building in an earthquake-prone area needs a solid foundation to survive. Similarly, if we keep strengthening the foundation of our faith, we can remain steadfast and loyal when trials come. (1 Corinthians 15:58; Colossians 1:23)
direct.tl: Kailangang matibay ang pundasyon ng pananampalataya natin dahil puwede tayong mayanig ng mga pagsubok, gaya ng building na nayayanig ng lindol. Para hindi gumuho ang building, kailangan nito ng matibay na pundasyon. Sa katulad na paraan, kung patuloy nating pinatitibay ang faith natin, mananatili tayong matatag at tapat kapag may pagsubok. (1 Corinto 15:58; Colosas 1:23)

deeper.en: Colossians 1:23 teaches me that faith must be stable, not temporary. Jehovah is loving because he tells us to strengthen the foundation before the earthquake comes. Spiritual preparation is not fear; it is wisdom. When my faith is built on solid truths, trials may shake me emotionally, but they do not have to move me away from Jehovah.
deeper.tl: Itinuturo ng Colosas 1:23 na ang pananampalataya ay dapat matatag, hindi pansamantala. Maibigin si Jehova dahil sinasabi niyang patibayin ang pundasyon bago dumating ang lindol. Ang spiritual preparation ay hindi takot; wisdom ito. Kapag matibay ang foundation ng faith ko, puwede akong mayanig emotionally pero hindi kailangang lumayo kay Jehova.

paragraph.en: To illustrate the importance of having a strong foundation for our faith, think of a building constructed in an area prone to earthquakes. Such a building needs a strong foundation in order to survive. Similarly, in order for us to survive tests of faith like those mentioned in the preceding paragraph, our faith needs a solid foundation. If we keep strengthening the foundation of our faith, we will continue to be steadfast, loyal servants of Jehovah in the face of trials.​— 1 Cor. 15:58 ; read Colossians 1:23 .
paragraph.tl: Bakit mahalaga na matibay ang pundasyon ng pananampalataya natin? Pag-isipan ang ilustrasyong ito: Para hindi gumuho ang isang building kahit magkaroon ng lindol, dapat na matibay ang pundasyon nito. Para makayanan din natin ang mga pagsubok na binanggit sa naunang parapo, dapat nating patibayin ang pundasyon ng pananampalataya natin. Kung patuloy nating gagawin iyan, makakapanatili tayong tapat kay Jehova anuman ang mapaharap sa atin.​— 1 Cor. 15:58 ; basahin ang Colosas 1:23 .

question.en: What helped the apostles to remain loyal to Jesus?
question.tl: Ano ang nakatulong sa mga apostol na manatiling tapat kay Jesus?

direct.en: Three truths helped the apostles remain loyal to Jesus. They were convinced that Jehovah is worthy of worship because he made all things; that Jesus is God's Son and has sayings of everlasting life; and that Jesus has Jehovah's support. The article focuses on three similar truths that help us remain loyal today.
direct.tl: Tatlong katotohanan ang nakatulong sa mga apostol na manatiling tapat kay Jesus. Kumbinsido sila na karapat-dapat sambahin si Jehova dahil siya ang lumalang sa lahat; na si Jesus ang Anak ng Diyos at nasa kaniya ang mga salitang nagbibigay ng buhay; at na sinusuportahan ni Jehova si Jesus. Tatalakayin din sa artikulo ang tatlong katotohanang tutulong sa atin.

deeper.en: This paragraph shows that loyalty grows from conviction. The apostles were not simply attached to a group; they were convinced about Jehovah, Jesus, and divine backing. Since no scripture is cited in the paragraph, the application is simple: when my loyalty is based on truth, not just routine, I can remain steady when emotions are tested.
deeper.tl: Ipinapakita nito na ang loyalty ay galing sa conviction. Hindi lang attached ang mga apostol sa isang grupo; kumbinsido sila tungkol kay Jehova, kay Jesus, at sa suporta ng Diyos. Dahil walang binanggit na teksto rito, simple ang application: kapag nakabase sa katotohanan ang loyalty ko, hindi lang routine, mananatili akong matatag.

paragraph.en: What helped the apostles to remain loyal to Jesus when many others abandoned him? The apostles were convinced that Jehovah is worthy of worship because he is the Maker of all things; that Jesus is God’s Son, who has “sayings of everlasting life”; and that Jesus has Jehovah’s full support. Now rather than consider many specific ways our faith can be tested, let us focus on three truths that can help us stay firmly grounded regardless of what tests we may face. They are: (1) Jehovah is the Creator of all things. (2) Jehovah inspired the Bible. (3) Jehovah is backing his people today. If we are thoroughly convinced of these three truths, we will remain loyal when we undergo tests of faith.
paragraph.tl: Bakit nakapanatiling tapat kay Jesus ang mga apostol noong iniwan siya ng iba? Kumbinsido kasi sila na karapat-dapat si Jehova sa pagsamba dahil nilalang niya ang lahat ng bagay. Naniniwala rin sila na si Jesus ang Anak ng Diyos at nasa kaniya ang “mga salitang nagbibigay ng buhay na walang hanggan.” At alam din nila na sinasang-ayunan ni Jehova si Jesus. Ngayon, imbes na isa-isang talakayin ang mga puwedeng maging pagsubok sa pananampalataya natin, magpokus tayo sa tatlong katotohanang ito na makakatulong sa atin na manatiling matatag: (1) Si Jehova ang Maylalang ng lahat ng bagay. (2) Mula kay Jehova ang Bibliya. (3) Ang mga Saksi ni Jehova ang bayang sinusuportahan ng Diyos sa ngayon. Kung talagang kumbinsido tayo sa tatlong katotohanang ito, makakapanatili tayong tapat kahit may mga pagsubok.

question.en: Of what does Revelation 4:11 remind us, but what might happen when we face tests of faith?
question.tl: Ano ang sinasabi ng Apocalipsis 4:11 tungkol kay Jehova, at paano iyan makakatulong sa atin kapag may pinagdadaanan tayo?

direct.en: Revelation 4:11 reminds us that Jehovah created all things, so he is worthy of our worship. Meditating on his power convinces us that he can deliver us from trials. But Satan spreads propaganda to make people doubt God's existence. If we are not fully convinced that Jehovah is the Creator and loves us, tests of faith may make us doubt that he will help us. (Revelation 4:11; Hebrews 11:6)
direct.tl: Ipinaaalala ng Apocalipsis 4:11 na nilalang ni Jehova ang lahat ng bagay, kaya karapat-dapat siyang sambahin. Kapag pinag-iisipan natin ang kapangyarihan niya, nagiging kumbinsido tayo na kaya niya tayong tulungan sa mga pagsubok. Pero nagpapakalat si Satanas ng kasinungalingan para pagdudahan ng tao ang Diyos. Kung hindi tayo kumbinsidong si Jehova ang Maylalang at mahal niya tayo, baka magduda tayo kapag may pagsubok. (Apocalipsis 4:11; Hebreo 11:6)

deeper.en: Revelation 4:11 helps me connect creation with trust. If Jehovah made all things, then no trial is bigger than his power. Hebrews 11:6 adds that faith includes believing that he rewards those seeking him. So Jehovah is not only powerful; he is caring. That combination strengthens loyalty.
deeper.tl: Tinutulungan ako ng Apocalipsis 4:11 na iugnay ang paglalang sa pagtitiwala. Kung nilalang ni Jehova ang lahat, walang pagsubok na mas malaki kaysa kapangyarihan niya. Idinadagdag ng Hebreo 11:6 na ginagantimpalaan niya ang humahanap sa kaniya. Kaya si Jehova ay hindi lang makapangyarihan; mapagmalasakit din siya.

paragraph.en: Read Revelation 4:11 . This text reminds us that Jehovah created all things. This fact alone makes him worthy of our worship. And when we meditate on his awe-inspiring power, we become convinced that he can deliver us from all our trials. However, Satan has filled this world with propaganda designed to make man doubt the existence of God. Scientists may even claim that life came about on its own. If we are not absolutely convinced that Jehovah is the Creator and that he loves us, we may begin to doubt that he is and that he will come to our aid when we are confronted with tests of faith.​— Heb. 11:6 .
paragraph.tl: Basahin ang Apocalipsis 4:11 . Ipinapaalala sa atin ng tekstong ito na nilalang ni Jehova ang lahat ng bagay. Kaya talagang karapat-dapat siya sa pagsamba natin. At kapag pinag-iisipan natin kung gaano kalakas ang kapangyarihan niya, nagiging kumbinsido tayo na kaya niya tayong tulungan kahit ano pa ang mapaharap sa atin. Pero gusto ni Satanas na isipin ng mga tao na walang Diyos. At para magawa iyan, nagkalat siya ng kasinungalingan sa mundo. May mga scientist pa nga na nagsasabing bigla na lang lumitaw ang buhay. Kaya napakahalagang tiyakin natin na kumbinsido tayong si Jehova ang Maylalang at mahal niya tayo. Kasi kung hindi, baka magduda tayo kung totoo siya at kung talagang tutulungan niya tayo kapag may pinagdadaanan tayo.​— Heb. 11:6 .

question.en: What should you do if you start to doubt that Jehovah is the Creator? (See also picture.)
question.tl: Ano ang dapat mong gawin kung nagsisimula ka nang magduda na si Jehova ang Maylalang? (Tingnan din ang larawan.)

direct.en: If we start to doubt that Jehovah is the Creator, we should take immediate action. We can research our publications, such as Was Life Created?, The Origin of Life, the "Was It Designed?" series, and Is There a Creator Who Cares About You? Studying evidence for God's existence strengthens faith, reveals Jehovah's personality, and equips us to help others. (Romans 1:20)
direct.tl: Kung nagsisimula tayong magduda na si Jehova ang Maylalang, dapat tayong kumilos agad. Puwede tayong mag-research sa mga publikasyon natin, gaya ng Saan Nagmula ang Buhay?, The Origin of Life, seryeng "May Nagdisenyo Ba Nito?," at Is There a Creator Who Cares About You? Ang pag-aaral ng ebidensiya tungkol sa Diyos ay magpapatibay ng faith at makakatulong din sa iba. (Roma 1:20)

deeper.en: Romans 1:20 teaches me that Jehovah has not hidden himself. Creation gives evidence of his power and qualities. I appreciate that the paragraph says to act immediately when doubts begin. Jehovah gives us abundant evidence, but we must care enough about our faith to examine it and make it our own.
deeper.tl: Itinuturo ng Roma 1:20 na hindi itinago ni Jehova ang kaniyang sarili. Ang creation ay nagbibigay ng ebidensiya ng kapangyarihan at mga katangian niya. Nagustuhan ko na sinasabi ng paragraph na kumilos agad kapag nagsisimula ang doubt. Nagbibigay si Jehova ng maraming ebidensiya, pero kailangan nating suriin ito at gawing personal ang faith.

paragraph.en:
If you start to doubt that Jehovah is the Creator, take immediate action. Thoroughly research our publications for information regarding the overwhelming proof that Jehovah created all things. You can find an abundance of faith-strengthening material on this subject in the brochures Was Life Created? and The Origin of Life​—Five Questions Worth Asking . Additional corroborating evidence is discussed in the series “ Was It Designed? ” found on jw.org. Jessica, a young sister in the United States, says: “After reading the Origin of Life brochure, I felt confident that the facts point to an intelligent Designer. I already knew this, but after reviewing the reasoning in that brochure, I proved it to myself beyond any reasonable doubt.” Also, many have benefited from reviewing the book Is There a Creator Who Cares About You? You may have already read this material. But why not read it again?

For your next personal study project, you might consider facts that prove God’s existence. Your research not only will help you to strengthen your faith in Jehovah’s existence but will shed light on his personality. ( Rom. 1:20 ) In addition, you will be able to use what you learn to help others who may have doubts about God’s existence. The main point: Jehovah has given us an abundance of evidence that he is our Creator.
paragraph.tl:
Kung nagsisimula ka nang magduda na si Jehova ang Maylalang, kumilos agad. Maghanap sa mga publikasyon natin ng mga ebidensiya na nilalang ni Jehova ang lahat ng bagay. Marami kang makikita sa mga brosyur na Saan Nagmula ang Buhay? at The Origin of Life—Five Questions Worth Asking . Baka makatulong din sa iyo ang serye sa jw.org na “ May Nagdisenyo Ba Nito? ” Sinabi ng kabataang sister na si Jessica, na taga-United States: “Habang binabasa ko ang brosyur na Origin of Life, nakita ko ang mga ebidensiya na meron talagang isang matalinong Disenyador. Alam ko naman iyon noon pa, pero pagkatapos kong mabasa ang mga paliwanag sa brosyur, mas lalo akong naging sigurado na totoo iyon.” Malaking tulong din ang aklat na Is There a Creator Who Cares About You? Baka nabasa mo na iyan noon. Pero marami ang nakinabang nang basahin nila ulit iyan. Puwede mo ring gawin iyan.

Para sa susunod mong study project, puwede mong pag-aralan ang mga ebidensiya na talagang may Diyos. Mapapatibay niyan ang pananampalataya mo kay Jehova, at mas makikilala mo rin siya. ( Roma 1:20 ) Bukod diyan, magagamit mo rin ang napag-aralan mo para tulungan ang iba na nagdududa kung mayroon ba talagang Diyos. Kung magre-research ka, makikita mo na binigyan tayo ni Jehova ng napakaraming ebidensiya para patunayang siya ang Maylalang.

question.en: How do we view the Bible? (2 Timothy 3:16, 17)
question.tl: Bakit napakahalaga sa atin ng Bibliya? (2 Timoteo 3:16, 17)

direct.en: We view the Bible as a message from Jehovah to mankind. It answers life's important questions, explains Jehovah's will, and tells us what he wants us to do. Because we believe Jehovah is the Author of the Bible, it is the most important book in our life, and we want to understand and apply it. (2 Timothy 3:16, 17)
direct.tl: Itinuturing natin ang Bibliya bilang mensahe ni Jehova para sa tao. Sinasagot nito ang mahahalagang tanong sa buhay, ipinapaliwanag ang kalooban ni Jehova, at sinasabi kung ano ang gusto niyang gawin natin. Dahil naniniwala tayong si Jehova ang Awtor ng Bibliya, ito ang pinakamahalagang aklat sa buhay natin, at gusto natin itong maintindihan at maisabuhay. (2 Timoteo 3:16, 17)

deeper.en: Second Timothy 3:16, 17 teaches me that Jehovah does not leave us without direction. He speaks through a book that can teach, correct, and equip us. That draws me closer to him because the Bible is not just information. It is Jehovah lovingly preparing us to live in a way that pleases him.
deeper.tl: Itinuturo ng 2 Timoteo 3:16, 17 na hindi tayo iniiwan ni Jehova na walang direction. Nagsasalita siya sa pamamagitan ng aklat na nagtuturo, nagtutuwid, at nagsasanay sa atin. Mas napapalapit ako sa kaniya dahil ang Bibliya ay hindi lang information; paraan ito ni Jehova para ihanda tayong mamuhay sa paraang nagpapasaya sa kaniya.

paragraph.en: Read 2 Timothy 3:16, 17 . The Bible is a message from Jehovah to mankind. It answers life’s important questions and tells us what Jehovah’s will is and what he wants us to do. We believe that Jehovah is the Author of the Bible, which makes the Bible the most important book in our life. We want to be sure that we understand his Word and do our very best to apply it.
paragraph.tl: Basahin ang 2 Timoteo 3:​16, 17 . Mababasa sa Bibliya ang mensahe ni Jehova para sa mga tao. Sinasagot nito ang mahahalagang tanong natin sa buhay, at sinasabi rin nito kung ano ang kalooban ni Jehova at kung ano ang gusto niyang gawin natin. Naniniwala tayo na si Jehova ang Awtor ng Bibliya, kaya ito ang pinakamahalagang aklat para sa atin. Dahil diyan, sinisikap nating maunawaan at maisabuhay ito.

question.en: What convinces you that the Bible is inspired of God?
question.tl: Ano ang nakakumbinsi sa iyo na mula sa Diyos ang Bibliya?

direct.en: Many things convince us that the Bible is inspired of God. It is historically accurate, accurate when discussing the natural world, widely distributed despite opposition, and harmonious though written by about 40 men over 1,600 years. Its timeless advice helps millions, and many prophecies have been fulfilled. (Luke 3:1, 2; Job 26:7; Proverbs 13:20; 15:21; Matthew 7:12; Joshua 23:14)
direct.tl: Maraming bagay ang nakakumbinsi sa atin na mula sa Diyos ang Bibliya. Tumpak ito sa kasaysayan at sa sinasabi nito tungkol sa kalikasan. Pinakalaganap itong aklat kahit sinikap ni Satanas na alisin ito. Magkakasuwato ang laman nito kahit isinulat ng mga 40 lalaki sa loob ng 1,600 taon. Nakakatulong ang payo nito, at maraming hula nito ang natupad. (Lucas 3:1, 2; Job 26:7; Kawikaan 13:20; 15:21; Mateo 7:12; Josue 23:14)

deeper.en: Joshua 23:14 reminds me that Jehovah's promises do not fail. The Bible's accuracy and fulfilled prophecy show that its Author sees more than humans can see. That strengthens loyalty because when a test of faith comes, I am not trusting human guesses. I am trusting the reliable Word of Jehovah.
deeper.tl: Ipinaaalala ng Josue 23:14 na hindi nabibigo ang mga pangako ni Jehova. Ang accuracy ng Bibliya at natupad na mga hula ay nagpapakitang ang Awtor nito ay nakakakita nang higit kaysa tao. Pinapatibay nito ang loyalty ko dahil kapag may test of faith, hindi hula ng tao ang pinagkakatiwalaan ko; Salita ni Jehova.

paragraph.en: Why are we convinced that Jehovah inspired the Bible? For a number of reasons. God’s Word is historically accurate. ( Luke 3:1, 2 ) It is also accurate when it discusses the natural world. ( Job 26:7 ) The Bible is the most widely distributed book of all time, despite Satan’s countless efforts to have it eliminated. The Bible was written by some 40 different men over a period of about 1,600 years; yet, their message is harmonious. It contains timeless advice that has helped millions in their everyday life. ( Prov. 13:20; 15:21; Matt. 7:12 ) And numerous Bible prophecies have been fulfilled, further proof of the Bible’s reliability. ( Josh. 23:14 ) Yes, the Bible is most certainly inspired of God!
paragraph.tl: Bakit tayo kumbinsido na mula kay Jehova ang Bibliya? Marami tayong dahilan. Tumpak ang Bibliya pagdating sa kasaysayan. ( Luc. 3:​1, 2 ) Tumpak din ang sinasabi nito pagdating sa mundo at kalikasan. ( Job 26:7 ) Espesyal din ang Bibliya kasi kahit tinangka ni Satanas na pigilan ang mga tao na mabasa ito, ito pa rin ang aklat na may pinakamaraming kopya sa mundo. Isinulat ng mga 40 lalaki ang Bibliya sa loob ng mga 1,600 taon, pero hindi nagkokontrahan ang nilalaman nito. Hindi naluluma ang payo ng Bibliya, at milyon-milyong tao na ang natulungan nito. ( Kaw. 13:20; 15:21; Mat. 7:12 ) Ito pa ang isang patunay na maaasahan ang Bibliya: Napakaraming hula nito ang natupad na. ( Jos. 23:14 ) Maliwanag, mula talaga sa Diyos ang Bibliya!

question.en: What should we do if we begin to have doubts that the Bible is inspired of God?
question.tl: Ano ang dapat nating gawin kung nagsisimula na tayong magduda na mula sa Diyos ang Bibliya?

direct.en: If doubts begin, we should pray and then act in harmony with our prayers. Like Jordan, we may need to think things through and do research in our publications to resolve questions. As we keep strengthening our conviction that Jehovah inspired the Bible, we strengthen the foundation of our faith. (1 Corinthians 3:12, 13)
direct.tl: Kung nagsisimula ang pagdududa, dapat natin itong ipanalangin at kumilos ayon sa panalangin natin. Gaya ni Jordan, baka kailangan nating pag-isipan ang mga bagay at mag-research sa mga publikasyon para masagot ang mga tanong. Habang pinatitibay natin ang tiwalang mula kay Jehova ang Bibliya, tumitibay ang pundasyon ng pananampalataya natin. (1 Corinto 3:12, 13)

deeper.en: First Corinthians 3:12, 13 helps me picture faith as something we build with quality materials. Jehovah is patient with sincere questions, but he expects us to build. Prayer plus research shows humility. Instead of letting doubts sit and weaken us, we bring them to Jehovah and look for answers.
deeper.tl: Tinutulungan ako ng 1 Corinto 3:12, 13 na makita ang faith bilang bagay na itinatayo gamit ang matibay na materyales. Matiisin si Jehova sa sincere questions, pero inaasahan niyang kikilos tayo. Ang panalangin at research ay nagpapakita ng humility. Hindi natin hinahayaang lumaki ang doubts; inilalapit natin ito kay Jehova.

paragraph.en: What should we do if we begin to have doubts that the Bible is inspired of God? We should make it a matter of prayer and take action in harmony with our prayers. Note what a young brother named Jordan, who was raised as a Witness, says: “I don’t automatically believe everything that I’m told. I need to think things through for myself. In all honesty, I still have occasional doubts. But when I do, I try my best to do research in our publications in order to get answers to my questions and resolve my doubts.” As we continue to strengthen our conviction that Jehovah inspired the Bible, we will strengthen the foundation of our faith.​— 1 Cor. 3:12, 13 .
paragraph.tl: Ano ang dapat nating gawin kung nagsisimula na tayong magduda na mula sa Diyos ang Bibliya? Dapat natin itong ipanalangin, at dapat tayong kumilos ayon sa panalangin natin. Ito ang sinabi ng kabataang brother na si Jordan, na lumaking Saksi: “Hindi ako basta-basta naniniwala sa lahat ng sinasabi sa akin—kailangan ko munang pag-isipang mabuti ang mga iyon. Sa totoo lang, may mga pagdududa pa rin ako paminsan-minsan. Kaya ang ginagawa ko, nagre-research ako sa mga publikasyon natin para mawala iyon.” Kapag patuloy nating pinatibay ang pagtitiwala natin na mula kay Jehova ang Bibliya, titibay rin ang pundasyon ng pananampalataya natin.​— 1 Cor. 3:​12, 13 .

question.en: What should we do if we start to have doubts about who God's people are today?
question.tl: Ano ang dapat nating gawin kung nagsisimula na tayong magduda kung sino talaga ang bayan ng Diyos sa ngayon?

direct.en: If we begin to doubt who God's people are today, we should not let those doubts fester. We can ask: Who is doing their best to live by Bible standards? Who views the Bible as the authority on all matters? Who is doing Jehovah's will today? Thinking on those questions helps us resolve doubts. (2 Timothy 4:3, 4; Matthew 7:20, 21)
direct.tl: Kung nagsisimula tayong magduda kung sino ang bayan ng Diyos ngayon, hindi natin dapat hayaang tumagal ang pagdududa. Puwede nating itanong: Sino ang nagsisikap mamuhay ayon sa pamantayan ng Bibliya? Sino ang gumagamit sa Bibliya bilang authority sa lahat ng bagay? Sino ang gumagawa ng kalooban ni Jehova ngayon? (2 Timoteo 4:3, 4; Mateo 7:20, 21)

deeper.en: Matthew 7:20, 21 helps me see that Jehovah wants us to look at fruit and obedience, not claims alone. This is reassuring. Jehovah does not ask for blind loyalty. He gives us a way to reason on evidence and see where his will is being done.
deeper.tl: Tinutulungan ako ng Mateo 7:20, 21 na makita na gusto ni Jehova na tumingin tayo sa bunga at pagsunod, hindi sa claims lang. Nakakapagpatibay ito. Hindi humihingi si Jehova ng blind loyalty. Binibigyan niya tayo ng paraan para mangatuwiran sa ebidensiya at makita kung saan ginagawa ang kalooban niya.

paragraph.en: If we ever begin to harbor doubts that Jehovah’s Witnesses are the people God is backing today, we should not let such doubts fester. Instead, we can resolve our doubts by asking ourselves such questions as: ‘Who are truly doing their best to conform their lives to the Bible’s standards? Who view the Bible as an authority on all matters?’ ( 2 Tim. 4:3, 4 ) ‘Who are doing Jehovah’s will today?’​— Matt. 7:20, 21 .
paragraph.tl: Kung nagsisimula na tayong magduda na ang mga Saksi ni Jehova ang bayang sinusuportahan ng Diyos sa ngayon, dapat tayong kumilos agad. Para mawala ang pagdududa natin, puwede nating pag-isipan ang mga tanong na gaya nito: ‘Sino ang talagang nagsisikap na mamuhay ayon sa pamantayan ng Bibliya? Anong organisasyon ang gumagamit sa Bibliya bilang basehan ng mga paniniwala nila?’ ( 2 Tim. 4:​3, 4 ) ‘Sino ang gumagawa ng kalooban ni Jehova sa ngayon?’— Mat. 7:​20, 21 .

question.en: How are Jehovah's Witnesses being used to fulfill Matthew 24:14?
question.tl: Bakit masasabing ang mga Saksi ni Jehova ang ginagamit ng Diyos para tuparin ang hula sa Mateo 24:14?

direct.en: Jehovah's Witnesses are being used to fulfill Matthew 24:14 by preaching the good news of the Kingdom worldwide. Jesus foretold that this work would take place in the last days. God's people are preaching in over 240 lands and have stayed focused on this preaching and teaching work for more than 100 years. (Matthew 24:14; Matthew 28:19, 20)
direct.tl: Ginagamit ang mga Saksi ni Jehova para tuparin ang Mateo 24:14 dahil ipinapangaral nila sa buong lupa ang mabuting balita ng Kaharian. Inihula ni Jesus na mangyayari ito sa mga huling araw. Nangangaral ang bayan ng Diyos sa mahigit 240 lupain, at mahigit 100 taon na nilang pinagtutuunan ang pangangaral at pagtuturo. (Mateo 24:14; Mateo 28:19, 20)

deeper.en: Matthew 24:14 helps me see Jehovah's purpose moving forward globally. The preaching work is not just an activity; it is evidence that Jehovah is using his people. That strengthens loyalty because I can see that Jehovah's organization remains focused on what Jesus said must be done.
deeper.tl: Tinutulungan ako ng Mateo 24:14 na makita na sumusulong sa buong mundo ang layunin ni Jehova. Ang pangangaral ay hindi lang activity; ebidensiya ito na ginagamit ni Jehova ang bayan niya. Pinapatibay nito ang loyalty ko dahil nakikita kong nakapokus pa rin ang organisasyon sa ipinagawa ni Jesus.

paragraph.en: In connection with doing God’s will today, we can ask ourselves, ‘Who is doing the preaching work that Jesus foretold would take place during the last days?’ ( Matt. 24:14 ) The answer is crystal clear. God is using his people​—Jehovah’s Witnesses—​to do the preaching work. We alone are preaching the good news of God’s Kingdom in over 240 lands. We have been accomplishing this work for more than 100 years under Kingdom rulership. Yes, we have remained focused on our all-important preaching and teaching work.​— Matt. 28:19, 20 .
paragraph.tl: Pag-isipan ito: Kalooban ng Diyos na maipangaral ang katotohanan sa buong lupa bago dumating ang wakas. Kaya tanungin ang sarili, ‘Sino ang nangangaral ng mabuting balita sa ngayon?’ ( Mat. 24:14 ) Malinaw ang sagot. Ginagamit ng Diyos ang bayan niya—ang mga Saksi ni Jehova—para maipangaral ang mabuting balita sa mga tao. Tayo lang ang gumagawa niyan sa mahigit 240 lupain, at mahigit 100 taon na nating ginagampanan ang atas na iyan. Mula noon hanggang ngayon, ang pangangaral at pagtuturo ang pinakamahalagang gawain ng bayan ng Diyos.​— Mat. 28:​19, 20 .

question.en: How do Jehovah's Witnesses contribute to sanctifying God's name today? (Matthew 6:9; Isaiah 43:10)
question.tl: Paano napapabanal ng mga Saksi ni Jehova ang pangalan ng Diyos? (Mateo 6:9; Isaias 43:10)

direct.en: Jehovah's Witnesses contribute to sanctifying God's name by proudly bearing the name Jehovah and restoring it to its rightful place in the Bible. Many people do not know God's name, but the New World Translation includes Jehovah's name more than 7,000 times in the main text. We help others know and honor that name. (Matthew 6:9; Isaiah 43:10)
direct.tl: Napapabanal ng mga Saksi ni Jehova ang pangalan ng Diyos dahil ipinagmamalaki nilang dala nila ang pangalang Jehova at sinikap nilang ibalik ito sa tamang puwesto sa Bibliya. Marami ang hindi nakakakilala sa pangalan ng Diyos, pero sa Bagong Sanlibutang Salin, lumitaw ang pangalang Jehova nang mahigit 7,000 beses. (Mateo 6:9; Isaias 43:10)

deeper.en: Matthew 6:9 shows that sanctifying Jehovah's name was important to Jesus. Isaiah 43:10 shows that Jehovah wants witnesses who identify him. That makes our name meaningful. Being called Jehovah's Witnesses is not a label of pride; it is a responsibility to help people know the God behind the name.
deeper.tl: Ipinapakita ng Mateo 6:9 na mahalaga kay Jesus ang pagpapabanal sa pangalan ni Jehova. Ipinapakita ng Isaias 43:10 na gusto ni Jehova ng mga saksi na magpapakilala sa kaniya. Kaya makahulugan ang pangalan natin. Hindi ito label para magyabang; responsibilidad ito na tulungan ang iba na makilala ang Diyos.

paragraph.en: Read Matthew 6:9 and Isaiah 43:10 . We are identified by God’s personal name, Jehovah, and we are proud to be called Jehovah’s Witnesses. At a time when most of the world is ignorant of this name, we have restored it to its rightful place in the Bible. It is found more than 7,000 times in the main text of The New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures.
paragraph.tl: Basahin ang Mateo 6:9 at Isaias 43:10 . Mga Saksi ni Jehova tayo, at ipinagmamalaki natin na dala natin ang pangalan ng Diyos. Hindi alam ng marami sa ngayon na Jehova ang pangalan ng Diyos. Pero sinikap nating ibalik ang pangalang Jehova sa orihinal na mga puwesto nito sa Bibliya. Kaya mahigit 7,000 beses lumitaw ang pangalang iyan sa Bagong Sanlibutang Salin ng Banal na Kasulatan.

question.en: Why can we say that Jehovah's Witnesses are obeying the commandment found at John 13:34, 35? (See also picture.)
question.tl: Paano natin nasabi na sinusunod ng mga Saksi ni Jehova ang utos sa Juan 13:34, 35? (Tingnan din ang larawan.)

direct.en: We can say Jehovah's Witnesses obey John 13:34, 35 because our brotherhood shows love and unity in a divided world. We come from many backgrounds and places, yet we work to maintain peace and love among ourselves. Seeing this love, even in another congregation or country, strengthens our conviction that Jehovah is using his people. (John 13:34, 35)
direct.tl: Masasabi nating sinusunod ng mga Saksi ni Jehova ang Juan 13:34, 35 dahil nakikita sa kapatiran natin ang pag-ibig at pagkakaisa sa mundong hati-hati. Galing tayo sa iba't ibang background at lugar, pero sinisikap nating panatilihin ang kapayapaan at pag-ibig. Kapag nakikita natin ito kahit sa ibang kongregasyon o bansa, tumitibay ang tiwalang ginagamit ni Jehova ang bayan niya. (Juan 13:34, 35)

deeper.en: John 13:34, 35 teaches me that love is identifying evidence. Jehovah does not just organize people to work; he teaches them to love. That draws me closer to him because the brotherhood reflects his personality. Our unity is not perfect because we are perfect; it is remarkable because Jehovah is backing us.
deeper.tl: Itinuturo ng Juan 13:34, 35 na ang pag-ibig ay identifying evidence. Hindi lang inoorganisa ni Jehova ang tao para gumawa; tinuturuan niya silang magmahal. Mas napapalapit ako sa kaniya dahil ang kapatiran ay nagpapakita ng personalidad niya. Remarkable ang unity natin dahil sinusuportahan tayo ni Jehova.

paragraph.en: Read John 13:34, 35 . Our brotherhood is a modern-day miracle of love and unity, which stands out in a hostile and divided world. We come from all parts of the world, with different backgrounds and upbringings; yet, we do our best to have peace and love among ourselves. When traveling, have you ever visited a different congregation? The next time you do, reflect on the love and unity among our brothers and sisters. It will underscore that Jehovah is indeed using his Witnesses to accomplish his will today. Keeping this in mind can help us to remain loyal to Jehovah during any tests of faith.
paragraph.tl: Basahin ang Juan 13:​34, 35 . Sa mundo ngayon, maraming tao ang hindi nagkakasundo at walang pag-ibig sa kapuwa nila. Pero ibang-iba ang bayan ni Jehova. Mahal na mahal natin ang isa’t isa, at nagkakaisa tayo. At sinisikap nating panatilihin iyan kahit magkakaiba tayo ng pinagmulan at kinalakhan. Nasubukan mo na bang pumunta sa ibang lugar at dumalo sa isang kongregasyon doon? Kung oo, siguradong napansin mo na may pag-ibig din at pagkakaisa ang mga kapatid doon. Patunay iyan na tayong mga Saksi ni Jehova ang ginagamit ng Diyos para tuparin ang kalooban niya sa ngayon. Kung tatandaan natin na sinusuportahan tayo ni Jehova, makakatulong iyan para makapanatili tayong tapat anumang pagsubok ang mapaharap sa atin.

question.en: What challenging situations might we have to face, but what can we confidently say?
question.tl: Anong mahihirap na sitwasyon ang puwedeng mapaharap sa atin, pero ano pa rin ang masasabi natin?

direct.en: We may face challenging situations in these critical last days. The organization may make decisions we do not fully understand, or we may feel misunderstood or hurt by a brother or sister. Even if we do not immediately see a solution, we can remain loyal if we are convinced that Jehovah is the Creator, that the Bible is his Word, and that Jehovah's Witnesses are his people. (2 Timothy 3:1, 13)
direct.tl: Puwede tayong mapaharap sa mahihirap na sitwasyon sa mapanganib na mga huling araw. Baka may desisyon ang organisasyon na hindi natin lubos maintindihan, o baka masaktan tayo ng isang kapatid. Kahit hindi agad natin makita ang solusyon, mananatili tayong tapat kung kumbinsido tayo na si Jehova ang Maylalang, na mula sa kaniya ang Bibliya, at na ang mga Saksi ni Jehova ang bayan niya. (2 Timoteo 3:1, 13)

deeper.en: Second Timothy 3:1, 13 reminds me that difficult times should not surprise us. Jehovah told us what the last days would be like. That warning is loving because it prepares us emotionally. When a hard situation comes, I can say what Peter said: "Whom shall we go away to?" There is no better place than with Jehovah.
deeper.tl: Ipinaaalala ng 2 Timoteo 3:1, 13 na hindi na tayo dapat magulat sa hirap ng mga huling araw. Sinabi na ito ni Jehova. Maibigin ang babala niya dahil inihahanda tayo emotionally. Kapag may mahirap na sitwasyon, masasabi natin gaya ni Pedro: "Kanino kami pupunta?" Wala nang mas mabuting lugar kaysa kay Jehova.

paragraph.en:
We live in critical times that are hard to deal with, so these last days will be difficult for all of us. ( 2 Tim. 3:1, 13 ) We may face other challenging situations. God’s organization might make decisions that we do not fully understand. Or we might feel misunderstood or hurt by a brother or a sister. We might not immediately see a solution to our problem, or we might not get an answer to whatever it is that has affected us.

Despite the emotional turmoil these situations may cause, we can always be loyal to Jehovah if we are convinced that he is the Creator, that the Bible is his Word, and that Jehovah’s Witnesses are his people. As Peter said to Jesus, we too can say to Jehovah: “Whom shall we go away to? You have sayings of everlasting life.”
paragraph.tl:
Mapanganib at mahirap ang kalagayan sa mundo sa mga huling araw na ito. ( 2 Tim. 3:​1, 13 ) Bukod diyan, baka may iba pang mga hamon na mapaharap sa atin. Baka makatanggap tayo ng mga tagubilin na hindi natin lubusang maintindihan. Posible ring masaktan tayo ng isang kapatid. Kapag napaharap tayo sa ganiyang sitwasyon, baka hindi tayo agad makahanap ng solusyon o mapaisip tayo kung bakit iyon nangyari.

Anuman ang maramdaman natin dahil sa mga iyan, makakapanatili tayong tapat kay Jehova kung kumbinsido tayo na siya ang Maylalang, na mula sa kaniya ang Bibliya, at na tayong mga Saksi ni Jehova ang bayan niya. Gaya ng sinabi ni Pedro kay Jesus, masasabi rin natin kay Jehova: “Kanino kami pupunta? Nasa iyo ang mga salitang nagbibigay ng buhay na walang hanggan.”

direct.en: Knowing that Jehovah is the Creator helps us remain loyal because it proves he is worthy of our worship and powerful enough to help us. When we meditate on creation, we remember that Jehovah can deliver us from trials. That conviction protects us when Satan's world tries to make us doubt God's existence or care. (Revelation 4:11; Hebrews 11:6)
direct.tl: Ang pagkaalam na si Jehova ang Maylalang ay tumutulong sa atin na manatiling tapat dahil pinatutunayan nito na karapat-dapat siyang sambahin at makapangyarihan siyang tumulong. Kapag binubulay-bulay natin ang creation, naaalala nating kaya ni Jehova na iligtas tayo sa pagsubok. Pinoprotektahan tayo ng conviction na iyan laban sa pagdududa. (Apocalipsis 4:11; Hebreo 11:6)

deeper.en: This truth draws me close to Jehovah because creation shows both power and personality. Revelation 4:11 reminds me that Jehovah made all things, and Hebrews 11:6 reminds me that he rewards those seeking him. So creation does not just tell me Jehovah is real; it helps me trust that he is powerful and caring.
deeper.tl: Mas napapalapit ako kay Jehova dahil ipinapakita ng creation ang kapangyarihan at personalidad niya. Ipinaaalala ng Apocalipsis 4:11 na nilalang ni Jehova ang lahat, at ng Hebreo 11:6 na ginagantimpalaan niya ang humahanap sa kaniya. Kaya ang creation ay hindi lang ebidensiyang totoo siya; tumutulong din ito na magtiwala akong makapangyarihan at mapagmalasakit siya.

direct.en: Knowing that the Bible is God's Word helps us remain loyal because it gives us Jehovah's direction and answers life's important questions. Its accuracy, harmony, timeless advice, and fulfilled prophecy strengthen our confidence. When tests come, we can rely on the Bible as Jehovah's message, not merely human wisdom. (2 Timothy 3:16, 17; Joshua 23:14)
direct.tl: Ang pagkaalam na mula sa Diyos ang Bibliya ay tumutulong sa atin na manatiling tapat dahil nagbibigay ito ng direksiyon ni Jehova at sagot sa mahahalagang tanong sa buhay. Pinapatibay ng accuracy, harmony, practical na payo, at natupad na hula ang tiwala natin. Kapag may pagsubok, makakaasa tayo sa Bibliya bilang mensahe ni Jehova. (2 Timoteo 3:16, 17; Josue 23:14)

deeper.en: This truth makes Jehovah feel close because the Bible is how he speaks to us. Second Timothy 3:16, 17 shows that his words can correct and equip us. Jehovah does not leave us guessing during tests of faith. He gives counsel that is reliable enough to build our life on.
deeper.tl: Pinapalapit ako ng katotohanang ito kay Jehova dahil ang Bibliya ang paraan niya ng pakikipag-usap sa atin. Ipinapakita ng 2 Timoteo 3:16, 17 na ang kaniyang salita ay nagtutuwid at nagsasanay. Hindi tayo hinahayaan ni Jehova na manghula kapag may test of faith; nagbibigay siya ng maaasahang payo.

question.en: Jehovah is backing his people today
question.tl: Ang mga Saksi ni Jehova ang bayan ng Diyos

direct.en: Knowing that Jehovah is backing his people today helps us remain loyal because we see the evidence: Jehovah's Witnesses conform to Bible standards, preach the Kingdom worldwide, make Jehovah's name known, and show love and unity. These signs help us stay convinced that Jehovah is using his people to accomplish his will. (Matthew 7:20, 21; Matthew 24:14; Isaiah 43:10; John 13:34, 35)
direct.tl: Ang pagkaalam na sinusuportahan ni Jehova ang bayan niya ngayon ay tumutulong sa atin na manatiling tapat dahil nakikita natin ang ebidensiya: sinusunod ng mga Saksi ni Jehova ang pamantayan ng Bibliya, ipinapangaral ang Kaharian sa buong lupa, ipinapakilala ang pangalan ni Jehova, at nagpapakita ng pag-ibig at pagkakaisa. (Mateo 7:20, 21; Mateo 24:14; Isaias 43:10; Juan 13:34, 35)

deeper.en: This truth gives me stability when something in the congregation or organization is hard to understand. Jehovah's backing is seen in the overall fruit, not in whether I understand every detail immediately. That helps me stay humble, patient, and loyal while I keep looking at the evidence of Jehovah's blessing.
deeper.tl: Pinapatatag ako ng katotohanang ito kapag may bagay sa kongregasyon o organisasyon na hindi ko agad maintindihan. Nakikita ang suporta ni Jehova sa kabuuang bunga, hindi sa kung naiintindihan ko agad ang bawat detalye. Tinutulungan ako nitong manatiling humble, patient, at loyal habang tinitingnan ang ebidensiya ng pagpapala ni Jehova.
